PRJNA1025116

LOADING PACKAGES

library("DESeq2")
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(apeglm)
library(ggplot2)
library("EnhancedVolcano")
library("tidyr")
library(edgeR)
library(patchwork)
library(Biostrings)
library("seqinr")
library(vegan)
library(ape)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)

LOADING FILES

# load metadata
SRRs <- read.csv("metadata.csv", header = TRUE)
SRRs <- SRRs %>%
  separate(Library.Name, into = c("State", "time", "rep"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(State = ifelse(
    grepl("^PB", State),
    "infected",
    "control"
  )) %>%
  mutate(condition = paste0(time, "_", State, "_", rep), 
        time = as.numeric(time)) %>%
  arrange(time)

# load gene counts for each run
cts <- read.table("../counts_batch1.tsv", header = TRUE)
names(cts)[names(cts) == "run_accession"] <- "Run"

# select runs from PRJNA1025116
cts <- cts %>%
  filter(Run %in% SRRs$Run) %>%
  mutate(Gene_origin = ifelse(
    grepl("^CP", Chr),
    "Bacteria",
    "Phage"
  ))

cts$Geneid <- sub("^cds-", "", cts$Geneid)
cts$Geneid <- sub("^rna-", "", cts$Geneid)

# load defense systems of the bacteria obtained from defense finder
ds <- read.csv("defense_systems.csv", header = TRUE)[, c("Geneid", "protein_in_syst", "type")]

EDA

# Number of bacterial and phage gene counts per run
cts_per_run_b_p <- cts %>%
  left_join(SRRs, by = "Run") # join with SRR to get the condition to label

cts_per_run_b_p <- cts_per_run_b_p %>%
  group_by(condition, Gene_origin) %>%
  summarise(counts = sum(counts), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame()
colnames(cts_per_run_b_p)[colnames(cts_per_run_b_p) == "condition"] <- "Run"
# Plots bacteria and phage gene counts per run 
ggplot(cts_per_run_b_p, aes(x = Run, y = counts, fill = Gene_origin)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Phage" = "red", "Bacteria" = "darkblue")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Run",
    y = "# reads",
    fill = "Gene origin"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90) 
)

# Construction of a distance matrix for PCoA
dist_matrix_cts <- cts[c("Run", "Geneid", 'counts')] %>%
  group_by(Run, Geneid) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Run,
    values_from = counts, 
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(dist_matrix_cts) <- dist_matrix_cts$Geneid
dist_matrix_cts <- dist_matrix_cts[ , -1]

dist_matrix_cts <- vegdist(t(dist_matrix_cts), method = "euclidean")

# Compute principal coordinate decomposition
pcoa <- pcoa(dist_matrix_cts)

# Plot PCoA2 vs PCoA2
pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  Run = rownames(pcoa$vectors),
  Axis1 = pcoa$vectors[, 1],
  Axis2 = pcoa$vectors[, 2]
)
pcoa_df <- left_join(pcoa_df, SRRs, by = "Run")
pcoa_df <- pcoa_df %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(ifelse(State == "infected", "I", "C"), " ", time)
  )

ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, color = State, label = label)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.8, size = 3.5, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("infected" = "red",  
               "control" = "darkblue")   
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA 1 (", round(pcoa$values$Relative_eig[1] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA 2 (", round(pcoa$values$Relative_eig[2] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    color = "Condition")

COUNT MATRIX

cnt_matrix <- cts[cts$Gene_origin == "Bacteria", ] %>% 
# filter bacteria genes   
left_join(SRRs, by = "Run") %>%   
  select(Geneid, condition, counts) %>%   
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition,               
              values_from = counts,               
              values_fill = 0) %>%   
  as.data.frame()  
rownames(cnt_matrix) <- cnt_matrix$Geneid 
cnt_matrix <- cnt_matrix[ , -1] 
cnt_matrix <- cnt_matrix[, order(names(cnt_matrix))]

CLR

# Add pseudocount to avoid counts = 0
pseudocount <- min(cnt_matrix[cnt_matrix > 0])/10 
# Transform the cts_matrix dataframe into a Deseq object
dds_for_vst <- cnt_matrix + pseudocount

dds_for_vst <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(dds_for_vst), as.data.frame(colnames(dds_for_vst)), design = ~ 1)
# Apply a variance stabilizing transformation (VST) to the count data
vst <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_for_vst) %>%
  assay() %>%
  as.data.frame()

vst <- 2^(vst)

# Normalization by gene length
genes_length <- cts[match(intersect(rownames(vst), cts$Geneid), cts$Geneid), ]$Length
vst <- vst/(genes_length * 10^(-3))

# Centered Log2 Ratio (CLR)
clr <- log2(vst / exp(rowMeans(log(vst))))
plot_CLR <- function(protein, ds_type) {
  protein_clr <- clr[protein, ]

  protein_clr <- protein_clr %>%
    t() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rename(value = protein) %>%
    rownames_to_column("time_State_rep") %>%
    separate(time_State_rep, into = c("time", "State", "rep"), sep = "_") %>%
    mutate(time = as.numeric(time))

  # compute mean and se
  median_clr <- protein_clr %>%
    group_by(State, time) %>%
    summarise(
      median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
      .groups = "keep"
    )

  # Plot
  ggplot(median_clr, aes(x = time, y = median, color = State, group = State)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = median-sd, ymax = median+sd)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(
    values = c("infected" = "red",  
               "control" = "darkblue")   
    ) +
    ylim(-3, 3.2) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Defense system = ", ds_type),
      x = "Time post infection (min)",
      y = "CLR"
    )
}
plots <- list()

for (i in rownames(ds)) {
  plots[[i]] <- plot_CLR(ds[i, ]$protein_in_syst, ds[i, ]$type)
}

wrap_plots(plots[1:64], ncol = 5, nrow = 13)

DESEQ + VOLCANO PLOT FUNCTION (control vs infected)

deseq_volcano_c_i <- function(t) {
  # columns of cnt_matrix to select
  if (t == 240) {
    cols <- c(paste0(t,"_control_1"),
      paste0(t,"_control_2"),
      paste0(t,"_infected_1"),
      paste0(t,"_infected_2")
    )
  } else {
      cols <- c(paste0(t,"_control_1"),
      paste0(t,"_control_2"),
      paste0(t,"_infected_1"),
      paste0(t,"_infected_2"),
      paste0(t,"_infected_3")
    )
  }

  
  # construction of DESeq dataset
  if (t == 240) {
    coldata <- data.frame(
    row.names = cols,
    condition = factor(c("control", "control", "infected", "infected"))
  )
  } else {
    coldata <- data.frame(
    row.names = cols,
    condition = factor(c("control", "control", "infected", "infected", "infected"))
  )
  }
  
  
  countData <- round(cnt_matrix[,cols])
  
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = countData,
                                colData = coldata,
                                design = ~ condition)
  
  # differential expression analysis
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  res <- as.data.frame(results(dds, alpha = 0.1, pAdjustMethod = "fdr"))
  
  # label for defense genes 
  labels <- ds$type[match(rownames(res), ds$protein_in_syst)]
  labels[is.na(labels)] <- ""
  
  # add column labels (character and logical)
  res <- mutate(res, label=labels)
  res <- mutate(res, ds = factor(res$label != ""))
  
  # plot -Log10 FDR vs Log fold change
  plot <- ggplot(res, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = ds)) +
    geom_point(data = subset(res, ds == "FALSE"), color = "grey", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = subset(res, ds == "TRUE"), color = "darkgreen") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_label_repel(data = subset(res, ds == "TRUE" & padj < 0.05),
        aes(label = label), 
        size = 3, 
        max.overlaps = Inf, 
        show.legend = NA,
        colour = "black"
  ) +
    xlim(-6, 6) +
    ylim(-3, 20) +
    annotate("text", x=0, y=13, label = paste0(t, " min (C vs I)")) +
    theme_bw()


  return(plot)
}
plot0 <- deseq_volcano_c_i(0) 
plot5 <- deseq_volcano_c_i(5) 
plot10 <- deseq_volcano_c_i(10) 
plot30 <- deseq_volcano_c_i(30) 
plot120 <- deseq_volcano_c_i(120) 
plot150 <- deseq_volcano_c_i(150) 
plot180 <- deseq_volcano_c_i(180) 
plot240 <- deseq_volcano_c_i(240) 


plot0 + plot5 + plot10 + plot30 + plot120 + plot150 + plot180 + plot240 + plot_layout(nrow = 2)

FUNCTION DESEQ + VOLCANO PLOT (time 0 vs time t)

deseq_volcano_0_t <- function(t, state) {
  # columns of cnt_matrix to select
  if (state == "control") {
  cols <- c(
    paste0("0_", state, "_1"),
    paste0("0_", state, "_2"),
    paste0(t, "_", state, "_1"),
    paste0(t, "_", state, "_2"))
  } else if (t == 240) {
  cols <- c(
    paste0("0_", state, "_1"),
    paste0("0_", state, "_2"),
    paste0("0_", state, "_3"),
    paste0(t, "_", state, "_1"),
    paste0(t, "_", state, "_2"))
  } else {
cols <- c(
    paste0("0_", state, "_1"),
    paste0("0_", state, "_2"),
    paste0("0_", state, "_3"),
    paste0(t, "_", state, "_1"),
    paste0(t, "_", state, "_2"),
    paste0(t, "_", state, "_3"))
  }
  
  
  # construction of DESeq dataset
  if (state == "control") {
      coldata <- data.frame(
        row.names = cols,
        condition = factor(c("0", "0", "t", "t"))
      )
  } else if (t == 240) {
    coldata <- data.frame(
        row.names = cols,
        condition = factor(c("0", "0", "0", "t", "t"))
      )
  } else {
    coldata <- data.frame(
        row.names = cols,
        condition = factor(c("0", "0", "0", "t", "t", "t"))
      )
  }
  
  countData <- round(cnt_matrix[,cols])
  
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = countData,
                                colData = coldata,
                                design = ~ condition)
  
  # differential expression analysis
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  res <- as.data.frame(results(dds, alpha = 0.3))
  
  # label for defense genes 
  labels <- rownames(res) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  `colnames<-`("Geneid") %>%
  left_join(ds, by = "Geneid") %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(type), "", type)) %>%
  pull(label)
  
  # add column labels (character and logical)
  res <- mutate(res, label=labels)
  res <- mutate(res, ds = factor(res$label != ""))

  # plot -Log10 FDR vs Log fold change
  plot <- ggplot(res, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = ds)) +
    geom_point(data = subset(res, ds == "FALSE"), color = "grey", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = subset(res, ds == "TRUE"), color = "darkgreen") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_label_repel(data = subset(res, ds == "TRUE"& padj < 0.05),
        aes(label = label), 
        size = 3, 
        max.overlaps = Inf, 
        show.legend = NA,
        colour = "black"
  ) +
    xlim(-5.5, 5.5) +
    ylim(0, 15) +
    annotate("text", x=-2, y=15, label = paste0(state, " - time 0 VS ", t)) +
    theme_bw()


  return(plot)
}
plot_c_240 <- deseq_volcano_0_t(240, "control")
plot_i_240 <- deseq_volcano_0_t(240, "infected")

plot_c_240 + plot_i_240 + plot_layout(nrow = 1)
